title: Cartas de y para profesores principiantes. Un viaje en la Inserción Profesional Docente
summary: This book stems from a dialogue between teachers beginning their careers and those who support them in this endeavor. Through authentic, profound, and hopeful letters, it addresses the dilemmas, emotions, lessons learned, and discoveries that mark the transition into the teaching profession. Organized around five key themes—Self-Care and Mental Health, Life Project and Identity, Autonomy, Collaboration, and Leadership—this book proposes a collective journey of reflection, support, and growth.
